name: CaseOverlayTextHugExcluded
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "overlay-text-hug-excluded" (geometry). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a TEXT-bearing part in an overlay anatomy whose box IS its own shrink-to-fit measurement of the mounted sample string
